_authoring: This file holds the personal content behind /, /resume and /contact.
It ships mostly empty ON PURPOSE. A positioning sentence, an availability
line and a resume are claims about a real person, and PRD 12.2 forbids
inventing them. Fill these in yourself; the site builds and renders honest
Run `pnpm profile:verify` to see exactly what is still missing and why.
Only `links` is prefilled, with the GitHub URL already public in this repo.
Nothing else is assumed - including whether you want your email on a public
page at all. That is your decision, not a default.
